_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: PPU and queue basics, bank switching, far call ($D4C1-$D8E0). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): rendering off (`$D4C1`, slot `$C00F`)
regions.description: `JSR $D4E3` (NMI off), a read of PPUSTATUS, `$A3` := 0 and PPUMASK := `$FE` AND `$E7` (background and sprites off); `$D4CF` is the entry after the first part.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): rendering on (`$D4D5`)
regions.description: `$A3` := `$18`; `$FE` |= `$18` and PPUMASK written.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): NMI off (`$D4E3`)
regions.description: `$FF` AND `$7F` into PPUCTRL (`$D4E7` is the entry with the value in A).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): NMI and rendering on (`$D4ED`, slot `$C012`)
regions.description: Commit the scroll (`$D68B`), rendering on, then `$FF` |= `$80` into PPUCTRL.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): reset the scroll (`$D4FD`, slot `$C01B`)
regions.description: `$A6-$A9` := 0, `$FC`/`$FD` := the scroll, `$A2` := the nametable bits from `$FF`, `$A7`, `$A9` (the shadow of PPUCTRL bits 0-1).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): sprite 0 and hide the rest (`$D51E`)
regions.description: OAM sprite 0 := y A, tile `$FF`, attribute `$20` (behind the background), x 0; then every other sprite hidden (`$D536`: `$F8` in all of `$0204-$02FF`).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): hide all sprites (`$D534`, slot `$C015`)
regions.description: X := 0 and `$F8` into `$0200-$02FF` (a loop of 256).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): inline string, address in `$18/$19` (`$D53F`, slot `$C171`)
regions.description: Pops its return address as the pointer `$17:$16`; waits for room (`$D591` then `$D7C3`); the item is the stream's count byte and data with the PPU address taken from `$19:$18` instead of the stream, so two bytes shorter than `$D576`'s.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): inline string (`$D576`, slot `$C06F`)
regions.description: Pops its return address, sizes the item (`$D591`), waits for room (`$D7C3` while there is none) and copies the item (`$D5A5`); the return address is pushed back past the string (`$D58A`). **One item per call, not a run.**

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): size of the inline item (`$D591`)
regions.description: The count byte at `($16)+1`: under `$80` it is count + 3; `$80-$BF` also +3 (the count byte's low 7 bits); `$C0` and over a 9-byte item. Then `JMP $D6C0` (reserve): carry set = no room.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): copy the item (`$D5A5`)
regions.description: A bytes copied from the stream into the queue (`$0100,X`), the item committed (`$D6F7`), and the stream pointer `$17:$16` advanced past it.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): inline fill (`$D5CC`, slot `$C06C`)
regions.description: Exactly four inline bytes: count `$15`, PPU high `$19`, low `$18`, value `$14`; one run (`$D5F8`); the pointer advanced by 4.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): queue a run (`$D5F8`, slot `$C036`)
regions.description: Reserve `($15 AND $7F)` + 3 bytes (waiting), build the item `[count][hi][lo][value x count]` with the value `$14` repeated, commit. Count bit 7 = increment 32.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): read the pads (`$D626`)
regions.description: Strobe `$4016`; eight reads shift port 1 into `$F5` and `$00` and port 2 into `$F6` and `$01` (the second bit of each read - the expansion lines - goes to `$00`/`$01`). **A is bit 7, Right bit 0.**

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): read until two reads agree (`$D64C`, slot `$C01E`)
regions.description: Reads the pads twice (the DMC can corrupt a read) and repeats until `$F5`, `$F6`, `$00`, `$01` equal the previous reading; then `$D676` forms the held and new buttons: `$F7/$F8` = `$F5/$F6` OR `$00/$01` (held), `$F5/$F6` = held AND NOT the previous held (the new presses).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): commit the scroll (`$D68B`)
regions.description: PPUCTRL := `$FF`; PPUSCROLL := `$FD` (x), then `$FC` (y).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): inline jump table (`$D6AE` / `$D6B0`)
regions.description: `$D6AE` is `ASL A / TAY` (index in A); `$D6B0` pops the return address into `$01:$00` and pushes the target stored at `ret + Y + 1` (target - 1) for an `RTS`: the caller's table follows the `JSR` in the instruction stream.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): reserve queue room (`$D6C0`, slot `$C039`)
regions.description: A bytes wanted: A + `$21` (the queue length) must be under `$51`, and if it reaches `$31` or more the pending-row flag `$A5` must be 0 (the row staging area overlays `$0130+`). **Carry set = no room.** A is preserved.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): reserve, waiting (`$D6D3`, slot `$C04B`)
regions.description: As `$D6C0`, calling `$D7C3` (let the NMI drain) while there is no room.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): start an item (`$D6E0`, slot `$C03C`)
regions.description: `$25` := the size; **the pending count `$20` is zeroed (saved in `$24`) so the NMI sees no item while this one is built**; if the NMI emptied the queue meanwhile (`$21` changed) the saved count is dropped. Returns A = the offset at which to build the item (the queue length `$21`; 0 if the NMI emptied the queue meanwhile).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): commit an item (`$D6F7`, slot `$C03F`)
regions.description: `$21` += the size; `$20` := the saved count + 1 + carry (the NMI may now send it).

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to the bank in A (`$D705`, slot `$C003`)
regions.description: `$04` := A; Y saved; `LDA $FFF2,Y / STA $FFF2,Y`; Y restored.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 0 (`$D714`)
regions.description: `$04` := 0 and the same read-write on `$FFF2`; A saved.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 1 (`$D721`)
PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 2 (`$D72E`)
PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 3 (`$D73B`)
PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 4 (`$D748`)
PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 5 (`$D755`)
PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): switch to bank 6 (`$D762`)
PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): far call (`$D76F`, slot `$C006`)
regions.description: A and Y saved in `$10/$11`; the return address is popped into `$13:$12`, advanced past the three inline bytes and pushed back, then the caller's bank `$04`;

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): far call: return path
regions.description: see `$D76F`: the target's `RTS` lands at `$D788`, which saves A and Y, pulls the caller's bank and falls into `$D79C`.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): far call: the target
regions.description: Pushes the target (bytes 2 and 1 of the inline data, a fake return address) and reads the bank byte;

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): far call: switch
regions.description: `$04` := the bank, the table read-write, A and Y restored: the next `RTS` enters the target.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): one frame with the NMI on, then off (`$D7AA`)
regions.description: If the NMI is enabled (`$FF` bit 7) it is written to PPUCTRL, one frame is waited for (`$2B` changes), and the NMI is switched off again. Used by the queue drain while rendering is off.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): drain the queue (`$D7C3`, slot `$C045`)
regions.description: X and Y saved. Loop: the decompressor's step (`$DB52`); **with rendering off (`$FE` AND `$18` = 0) the main thread does the NMI's work: `$D7AA`, then five times `$DB52` and `$DD54` (the queue)**; until the decompressor state `$0B`, the pending row `$A5` and the queue count `$20` are all 0.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): arm the decompressor (`$D7F9`, slot `$C042`)
regions.description: A = the block number, Y = the bank (the low nibble indexes the table bases); `$18/$19` = the destination. **Waits if the decompressor is busy (`$0B` non-zero), then switches to the bank, reads the block's 16-bit pointer from base[bank] + 2 x block into `$0D:$0C`, sets `$0F:$0E` := the destination, `$06` := the bank and `$0B` := 2 (start).**

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): play sound A (`$D852`, slot `$C030`)
regions.description: The live bank saved; bank 0 (`$D714`); `JSR $8006` (the sound engine's play entry); the bank restored.

regions.name: PPU AND QUEUE BASICS (bank 7 `$D4C1-$D8E0`): redraw a 2 x 2 cell (`$D865`, slot `$C054`)
regions.description: A queue item of 9 bytes (`$D6D3`): type `$C0` + the nametable page, the PPU low byte, **four tiles and an attribute change**. A with its low two bits 0 puts the tiles A, A+2 / A+1, A+3 (the picture is column-major: top-left A, bottom-left A+1), `$20` four blanks; any other A takes four bytes from `$D8E0 + A` (rows `TL TR / BL BR`, the rubble and spark patterns). Y = the attribute byte's address low; the attribute change is the cell's quadrant (`$18` bits 1 and 6 pick it): `$EB00[q]` clears it, `$EB04[q]` AND `$17` sets the palette.
